recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E：上方為粉紅色纖維素樣壞死基質，下方是細胞核呈卵圓或腎形、染色質細緻、細胞質淡粉紅的類上皮組織球，底部夾雜含金棕色含鐵血黃素（hemosiderin）的巨噬細胞與紅血球。
features: Epithelioid histiocytes with oval to reniform vesicular nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Indistinct cell borders forming a syncytial-appearing sheet
Hemosiderin-laden macrophages with coarse golden-brown pigment and extravasated red cells (lower field)
describe_en: High-power H&E section of spleen shows sheets of epithelioid histiocytes with oval to reniform vesicular nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders, bordering an eosinophilic fibrinoid necrotic matrix. Hemosiderin-laden macrophages with coarse golden-brown pigment and scattered red cells are present at the periphery. No atypical large lymphoid cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with the histiocytic rim of a necrotizing granuloma.

ddx.vs: LCH cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei with accompanying eosinophils and are CD1a/langerin positive.
ALCL cells show marked atypia, horseshoe nuclei and CD30/ALK expression rather than bland epithelioid histiocytes.
FDC sarcoma forms fascicles or whorls of spindle cells positive for CD21/CD35 and is not associated with caseous necrosis.
